ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: on the left side of the figure there is a food chain sequence from bottom to top, with the bottom labeled "Phytoplankton", an upward arrow pointing to "Zooplankton", then upward pointing to "Planktivorous fish", and at the top is "Piscivorous fish". Then reason: the question asks for the organism at the top of the food chain in the figure. Following the arrows on the left upward, the highest trophic level is located at the top, so the answer is piscivorous fish.
